title: A Fortune 500 CEO just funded a scholarship named after her mother
sources: Careers360 - BITS Pilani Convocation 2026: USD 1 million endowment from alumna Revathi Advaithi for women's scholarships
American Bazaar - CEO Revathi Advaithi pledges $1M for women's scholarships
caption:
A Fortune 500 CEO just funded a scholarship named after her mother. For women from economically weaker backgrounds, at her old engineering college.

Revathi Advaithi, CEO of Flex and a BITS Pilani alumna and her husband Jeevan Mulgund endowed a $1 million permanent scholarship fund during her address as chief guest at BITS Pilani's July 2026 convocation. The fund is named the Visalam Swamy and Sucheta Mulgund Scholarship, after both of their mothers and will support women from economically weaker backgrounds every year going forward.

She was the only woman in her engineering class. Now she's funding a future where that's never true again.
